mie - windows_x86_64 build

built     : 2026-09-29
platform  : Windows x86_64 (MSVC 19.51)
backend   : cpu
optim     : release
tflite    : 2.18.0 (prebuilt)

layout:
  include/  public headers, add -Iinclude
  lib/      mie.lib (static library)
  bin/      mie_run.exe plus tensorflowlite_c.dll (runtime dependency)
  examples/ run_model.cc, the demo driver (built as bin/mie_run.exe)
  testdata/ demo models (ssd/detect.tflite + labelmap.txt)
  README.md full documentation

Runtime note: mie_run.exe loads tensorflowlite_c.dll from its own directory.
Keep bin/ files together. GPU/QNN/MTK backends are not available in the
Windows build (GPU delegate ships only for Android; QNN/MTK require the
vendor's device runtime).

Integration note: link mie.lib into your application and add -Iinclude.
mie.lib was built against the prebuilt tensorflowlite_c.dll import library
(tensorflowlite_c.dll.if.lib); ship tensorflowlite_c.dll alongside your exe.
